issues.explanation: Here で marks the means or language (“in French”), while なく is the continuative negative form; describing the whole as a negative copula form is inaccurate.
issues.suggested_fix: Describe it as 「で」 plus 「なく」, meaning “not in French,” contrasted with 「英語で」.

issues.explanation: The adverbial particle に should be segmented separately from 熱心.
In 紹介し, this is the inflected lexical verb する, not an auxiliary.
issues.suggested_fix: Classify it as a word/verb, keeping lemma 「する」.

issues.suggested_fix: Set the overlay surface to 「恐ろしいほどだ」 with the corresponding adjusted offsets.
